composer: W. A. Mozart (piano variation setting of the French song Ah, vous dirai-je, Maman)
title: 12 Variationen über Ah vous dirais-je, Maman, K.265 (300e), Tema
edition: Mozarts Werke, Serie XXI, No.6. Leipzig: Breitkopf & Härtel, 1878, plate W.A.M.265.
method: Visually read the rendered first page of the historical piano edition, not inferred from the familiar song.

changes: omit left-hand part and written repeat
bar 4: replace two repeated quarter Gs with one half G
bar 7: omit final sixteenth E and extend dotted eighth D to quarter D
assign project right-hand fingers and two released position changes; no fingering printed in these source bars

rights: Historical 1878 engraving; public-domain score listed by IMSLP. No modern editorial fingering copied.
limits: Do not call Mozart the composer of the underlying French tune. Historical composition date printed on the old edition is not adopted as verified biography. This is a simplified project adaptation, not a literal fragment or original Mozart fingering.
